chunks: When the single blast is sounded on the trumpet,

key_terms.الصُّور: The Trumpet blown by the Angel to signal the Resurrection

ai.seo_question: What happens when the Trumpet is blown for the first time?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'single blow' (Nafkhah Wahidah) is distinguished from the second blow that causes death, marking the moment of universal awakening and the commencement of the Day of Judgment. This event underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah in initiating the cosmic transition, a theme frequently elaborated upon by Imams such as Al-Baqir and Al-Sadiq to highlight the immediacy of divine reckoning.
